patch_description: Restructure the program into a modular pipeline: (1) seed builders produce diverse feasible starting configurations (hex lattice variants, corner-anchored layouts, jittered copies), (2) each seed is handed to a scipy nonlinear optimizer (`trust-constr` with analytic Jacobians, falling back to SLSQP) that jointly optimizes all 52 variables (26 centers × 2 coords + 26 radii) to maximize the radius sum subject to non-overlap and wall constraints, (3) a vectorized feasibility repair fixes any tiny violations from the solver, and (4) the best candidate is kept. This replaces the greedy grow/nudge heuristic with true constrained optimization, which per prior evidence dominates the achievable score, and modularizes seed generation, refinement, repair, and selection into separate functions.
